picks.title: Clear dark sky tomorrow 1am
picks.body: 95% clear for about 5 h from 1am, moon 18% lit. Try Cottonwood Canyon State Park (International Dark Sky Park) (~150 km away).
why: 5 forecast hours with ≥60% clear sky in darkness (HRRR)

picks.title: Colourful sunrise likely tomorrow 6:56am
picks.body: 35% odds of colour. Best bets: Cottonwood Canyon State Park (International Dark Sky Park), Sauvie Island Wildlife Area (Reeder Rd & Rentenaar Rd), Scout pick: Summer sunrise behind Mt. Adams from Sauvie Island. Horizon toward the sun is 100% open.
why: 41% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 100% open (25–300 km)
